title: Luke and Acts: Jesus’s ministry and its continuation
author: Jason Meyer
sourceLocator: Sermon transcript, section “Chiastic Structure of Luke-Acts”, ten labeled units
note: Published pastoral interpretation, not a peer-reviewed consensus claim. Jason Meyer, Bethlehem Baptist Church, “Jesus, Continued”, November1,2020. All ten published source units retained; titles and explanations paraphrased by ChiFold. No unique singleton center is specified: the E/E′ hinge joins Luke24 with Acts1. This proposal is independent of Wolfe’s different Luke–Acts boundaries; do not merge them. Complete source outline. Reading alignment: verified; 0 of 10 elements currently lack a verified complete reading-edition mapping. Unmapped source coordinates never enter reader discovery.
